Class Sprite

java.lang.Object
app.Sprite
public class Sprite extends Object
Represents a sprite sheet composed of evenly sized frames arranged in a grid (rows × columns). This class provides:
  • Automatic calculation of each frame's width and height
  • Rendering of any frame index to a GraphicsContext
  • Support for customizable animation sequences
  • Methods for advancing to the next frame in the sequence
Sprite indices are numbered from 0 → (spriteCount - 1), scanning across rows first (left-to-right, then top-to-bottom).

This class does not perform timing; callers should advance frames using an animation loop such as AnimationTimer or Timeline.

  • Constructor Details

    • Sprite

      public Sprite(String resourcePath, int rows, int cols, int spriteCount)
      Constructs a Sprite from a sprite sheet image.
      Parameters:
      resourcePath - the resource path (path after /src/main/resources/... ) use linux style paths for windows invalid input: '&' linux
      rows - number of rows the sheet is divided into
      cols - number of columns the sheet is divided into
      spriteCount - total number of valid frames in the sheet (supports sheets where the last row is partially filled)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if parameters are invalid

    • Sprite

      public Sprite(javafx.scene.image.Image sheet, int rows, int cols, int spriteCount)
      Constructs a Sprite from a sprite sheet image.
      Parameters:
      sheet - the full sprite-sheet image (must not be null)
      rows - number of rows the sheet is divided into
      cols - number of columns the sheet is divided into
      spriteCount - total number of valid frames in the sheet (supports sheets where the last row is partially filled)
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if parameters are invalid

      public void setAnimationSequence(List<Integer> sequence)
      Replace the current animation sequence with a custom one. All frame indices must be between 0 and spriteCount-1.
      Parameters:
      sequence - ordered list of frame indices
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if invalid or empty

      Advances to the next frame in the animation sequence.

      public void render(javafx.scene.canvas.GraphicsContext gc, int spriteIndex, double x, double y, double destWidth, double destHeight)
      Custom render a specific frame index from the sprite sheet.
      Parameters:
      gc - the GraphicsContext to draw into
      spriteIndex - which frame to render (0-based)
      x - destination X coordinate on the canvas
      y - destination Y coordinate on the canvas
      destWidth - width to draw the frame on screen
      destHeight - height to draw the frame on screen
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if spriteIndex is invalid
